newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice ends higher as Jordan buys U.S. supplies.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice ends higher as Jordan buys U.S. supplies.

text.p: CBOT rice futures ended higher on Tuesday, boosted by news Jordan bought at least 15,000 tonnes U.S. rice, traders said.
"We weren't really expecting (Jordan) to come here," a trader said.
U.S. exporters confirmed that Jordan on Tuesday bought 15,000 tonnes of California rice for $407 per tonne, free on truck, for April shipment. Jordan had tendered for up to 30,000 tonnes.
Trade was said to be quiet with light commercial interest noted in the July/May spread, floor sources said.
Rice closed four to one cent per cwt higher with May up two at $11.42.
Volume was estimated by CBOT at 450 lots, compared with Monday's actual volume of 190 lots.
